headline: Holo-Battle Interlink
title: Aniimo Holo-Battle Interlink Explained | Weekly Alpha Boss Mode | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Holo-Battle Interlink is Aniimo's weekly boss mode, added in version one point one. Each week offers three routes, and every route has its own Alpha boss. You can go in with a team of up to four players, and A I teammates fill empty slots. Before each fight you pick your buffs, and your stars decide your weekly rewards. It resets every week, so jump in often. Have you cleared all three routes yet? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Holo-Battle Interlink explained: the weekly co-op Alpha boss mode with three routes, teams of up to four and weekly star rewards.
